arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 8 km, 1250 m legs. Calib CP boat 136 W, shaft 207 W (may be 10-25 pct off). Start hot as expected (shaft 249 W). Leg 1 into head current (-0.34 m/s). Goal: settle near sustainable shaft power by min 3, watch pod reserve w_bal_pod_frac; check whether CP looks wrong (reserve falling when at CP or not falling when above). Finish sprint ~last 600-800 m if reserve allows.

arguments.message: Still well above sustainable shaft power after the start
Pod reserve below 25 pct with more than 1200 m to go
Shaft power well below sustainable: leaving time on the water
Boat slower than pod power plus fitted current explains: possible drag (rudder weed) or current change

text: no cue: hard start is normal and should settle by itself; set watches for over-effort, low pod reserve, under-effort and a drag jump.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle a touch now, long strokes, save it for later.

Min 3.8 (713 m): shaft 246 W vs CP 207 (+19 pct) since start, pod reserve 52 pct, boat reserve 22 pct, no speed fade yet. Paddler: 6/10, all good, plenty. Possible CP underestimate (test can be 10-25 pct off) OR misjudging. Cued ease (no pace target). Check next: did shaft drop toward ~215 W; if pod reserve runs near 0 with no fade and still feels ok, raise cp_shaft (try ~230-235) via set_critical_power.

text: Cued ease: still 19 pct above calibrated critical power at min 4 with pod reserve at 52 pct, paddler feels fine so CP may be low; watching.

arguments.text: Ease a little. Steady rhythm now, we race the last two k.

Min 6.8 (1279 m, leg 2 south, current now helping): shaft fell 245->230 after first ease; pod reserve 26 pct (pod model consistent with spend since start), boat reserve 0 but boat numbers drift because fitted push lagged (-0.34 -> -0.26) - trust pod over boat. Paddler 7/10 plenty. Cued ease again aiming shaft ~210-215 to hold pod reserve ~25 pct for last 2 km. CP not changed: no evidence yet beyond self-report.

arguments.message: 1700 m to go: plan the finish, spend pod reserve

text: Cued ease: shaft 230 W vs CP 207 with pod reserve 26 pct and 6.7 km left; holding reserve for the last 2 km; added a 1700 m-to-go watch.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 12 pct with more than 1500 m to go

text: no cue: ease cue given 12 s ago is still taking effect; lowered the reserve watch to 12 pct.

arguments.message: Pod reserve empty yet shaft power held above CP for 2 min: CP likely underestimated
Shaft power dropped below 200 W: possible blow-up

arguments.text: Min 9.4 (1869 m): ease cues barely held (shaft back to 229 W). Pod reserve 11 pct, empties ~300 m. Evidence CP is too LOW: boat model reserve has read 0 for 4.5 min with boat power 150-157 W > CP 136 and no fade (fade -1.3 to -2.7 pct, flat); paddler 7/10 plenty; they have held ~235 W avg for 9 min = near their 12-min test power. Decision: no ease now, let pod reserve hit 0 as a live CP test. Watches: cp_test_empty (2 min above CP+10 at empty -> raise cp_shaft to ~228) and blowup (shaft < 200 W -> cue ease, CP was right).

text: no cue: letting the pod reserve run to empty as a live critical-power test (boat model at zero 4.5 min with no fade suggests CP is too low); watches set for blow-up and for holding power at empty.

arguments.text: Love it, but hold this effort. Six k left, save the go.

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to go harder with 6 km left and pod reserve at 8 pct; keep current effort while testing whether CP is underestimated.

arguments.text: Min 12.8 (2596 m, leg 3 north into current -0.35): pod reserve read 0 since ~min 11.3 (below 2 pct since ~min 11), shaft held 224-226 W, no power drop, fade only -2.7 to -3.2 pct. Hold cue at min 9.9 kept them from surging. If cp_test_empty fires and power still holds: raise cp_shaft to ~226-228 and boat cp to ~150 (boat model sat at 0 since min 5 with boat power 150-157).

text: no cue: paddler holding 226 W with pod reserve at zero for 1.5 min and no blow-up; waiting for the 2-min watch before correcting critical power.

arguments.reason: Paddler held 224-228 W shaft for over 2 min with pod reserve at zero (and boat 147-157 W with boat reserve at zero since min 5) with no power drop and only slight fade: pre-race test underestimated CP. 228 W is a lower bound from the race.

arguments.text: You are strong today. Lift it a little into this current.

arguments.message: Shaft power dropped below 212 W: possible blow-up after the push

arguments.text: Min 13.1: SET CP shaft 207->228, boat 136->150 (1 of 3 uses) after holding 224-228 W for 2+ min at pod reserve 0, no blow-up. Paddler 6/10 plenty (was 7 at min 6.8; said feeling great, got more at 9.8). Cued push on leg 3 (head current) to test whether true CP is higher still (~235-245). Watch blowup now at shaft < 212 W for 20 s: if it fires, cue ease and maybe lower CP back to ~222.

text: Raised critical power to 228 W shaft / 150 W boat after the paddler held it at an empty reserve with no blow-up; cued a small push into the head current, blow-up watch set.

arguments.text: Settle back a touch, smooth and long. Recover for the finish.

Min 16 (3185 m): push lifted shaft to 232-236 for ~2.5 min then faded to 224. Effort jumped 6 -> 9/10 (words still all good, plenty - words seem fixed, the number moves). Fade -3.5 pct. So true CP likely ~224-228 and the push spent real reserve. Cued ease to ~215-220 to recover before the finish. Do not push again until the last ~1.5 km; consider set_critical_power ~224 if blow-up signs.

text: Cued ease: effort rose to 9/10 after the push with 4.8 km left; recovering reserve to avoid a blow-up and keep something for the finish.

arguments.reason: Paddler blew up at min 16.3 (shaft 237 -> 172 W, fade -11 pct) after a 3-min push to 232-237 W. Mean shaft over the first 16 min was about 231 W; with the tested reserve of 18.6 kJ that gives CP near 212 W. My raise to 228 was too high; 215 is a better estimate.

arguments.text: Min 16.5 (3260 m): BLOW-UP. Shaft 172 W, fade -11 pct, effort was 9/10 at min 16. My CP raise to 228 was wrong (2 min at empty was not enough evidence). Reset CP shaft 215 / boat 142 (2 of 3 uses; 1 left). Avg shaft first 16 min ~231 W => CP ~212 if reserve 18.6 kJ. Plan now: let them recover, no pushes; steady near 205-210 W; finish push only in last ~600-800 m if pod reserve shows > 30 pct. Lesson: trust pod reserve model, effort number is informative, words are not.

arguments.message: Shaft power below 155 W: deep collapse
Paddler back above 200 W with pod reserve above 20 pct: recovered

text: no cue (gate closed 40 s, ease already given): paddler blew up after my push; reset critical power to 215 W shaft and set a recovery watch.
no cue: paddler is recovering from a blow-up (171 W at effort 8/10), so asking for more would not help; recovery watch will wake me.

arguments.text: Nice recovery. Hold exactly this effort, steady to the last k.

arguments.message: Shaft creeping above 226 W again before the finish: risk of second blow-up

arguments.text: Min 18.9 (3657 m): recovered to 214 W after ~2.5 min at 170-190 W. Pod reserve model (CP 215) 27 pct. Cued hold at ~214. Paddler tends to drift back up to ~228: watch creep_high (>226 W for 60 s) -> cue ease. Finish plan: finish_window watch at 1700 m to go; start finish push ~700-900 m out if pod reserve > 30 pct, else ~400 m.

text: Cued hold at about 214 W after recovery from the blow-up, with a watch for creeping back above 226 W.

arguments.text: Not yet. Hold this effort, we go hard at one k.

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to go harder with 3.9 km left, but they blew up after the last push; keep about 215 W until about 1 km out.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish now at 9250 m.

arguments.message: Cue gate open: TELL the paddler the finish moved to 9250 m (distance_left_m)

arguments.text: Min 21.4 (4178 m): RADIO - course extended one leg, finish now 9250 m. set_race_distance 9250 done. Must cue tell with distance_left_m (gate was closed 46 s) - watch tell_extension wakes me. finish_window watch (remaining < 1700) now fires at ~7550 m. Paddler wanted to go harder at min 21.1; cued hold at 21.2. With the extra leg, hold ~212-215 W even longer.

text: Set race distance to 9250 m after the radio extension; cue gate closed, so a watch will wake me to tell the paddler as soon as it opens.

arguments.text: Course extended a leg. Finish is 4.9 k from here.

Min 22.3 (4367 m): told paddler the finish is 4.9 k away (distance_left_m 4883, finish 9250 m). Holding ~218 W, pod reserve 26 pct (CP 215 model). Next: hold steady; finish push near 900-1000 m to go if reserve allows.

text: Told the paddler the finish moved: 4.9 km to go, so they pace for the extra leg.

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power plus fitted current explains for 45 s: possible weed on rudder or local current change

arguments.text: Min 25.3 (5008 m, start leg 5 north): leg 4 steady 211-218 W, water speed 3.22-3.25, no step change (slow 1.5 pct loss of speed per watt since leg 3, likely fatigue). Pod reserve 26 pct. Tightened drag_jump watch (local push 0.15 below fitted for 45 s) to catch weed on the rudder -> clear_rudder.

text: no cue: steady at about 214 W with 26 pct pod reserve and 4.2 km left, on plan; tightened the drag watch.

arguments.text: Min 28.3 (5526 m, leg 5 north into current): shaft 209-211 W, pod reserve 29 pct (CP 215 model), sustainable 220. Considered a small push into the current but paddler effort 8/10, so no push; save reserve for finish (~1 km out). Remaining 3724 m.

text: no cue: 209 W at effort 8/10 with 3.7 km left; saving the reserve for the finish rather than pushing into the current.

arguments.text: Min 31.3 (6045 m): shaft drifting 207-210 W, pod reserve 33 pct rising, effort 8/10 at min 28. Course: leg 6 south (helping) 6250-7500, leg 7 north into current 7500-8750, leg 8 south, finish 9250 (500 m into leg 8). FINISH PLAN: at the 7500 turn (finish_window watch fires ~7550) cue push into the current; at ~8750 turn (500 m to go) cue finish. Last cue must be before 9150 m.

arguments.message: About 550 m to go: cue the finish sprint now

text: no cue: holding about 208 W with reserve rebuilding; plan to push into the current on the second-last leg and sprint the last 550 m, watches set.

arguments.text: Reserve is back. Lift it now, strong and long, 2.6 k left.

Min 34.1 (6591 m): shaft had drifted to 203 W (21 W under sustainable 224), pod reserve 40 pct, effort 7/10 (down from 8). Cued push. Next: at 7500 turn push again into current; finish cue at 550 m to go. If effort hits 9 or shaft drops below 190, ease.

text: Cued push: paddler had drifted to 203 W, 21 W under sustainable, with 40 pct reserve and effort down to 7/10 at 2.7 km to go.
no cue: push is holding them at 215-217 W; the next push goes in after the turn into the current, which the 1700 m watch will flag.

arguments.text: Finish is 1.7 k away, not here. Settle, sprint at 500.

arguments.message: Check whether the paddler settled after the distance correction (cue gate open)

arguments.text: Min 38.6 (7556 m, just turned into leg 7, head current): paddler started sprinting on their own (shaft 267 W, rate 69) - likely aiming at the ORIGINAL 8000 m finish (told distance may fade). Pod reserve fell 39 -> 24 pct in a minute. Cued tell: finish 1.7 k (distance_left_m 1690), settle, sprint at 500. Target now ~222-225 W to 550 m to go, then finish cue. push_local -0.62 just after turn: check it is the turn and not weed.

text: Cued tell: paddler began sprinting 1.7 km out, apparently for the old 8000 m finish; told them the real distance and to sprint at 500 m.

arguments.text: Min 38.9 (7600 m): SUSPECT WEED ON RUDDER. push_local fell 0.34 -> 0.16 on leg 6 BEFORE the turn (about 7480 m), same moment shaft surged to 257-267 W; after the turn push_local -0.53 vs fitted current -0.35 (0.17 m/s deficit). Extra 50 W gave no extra water speed (3.24). Paddler may be working harder against the drag, burning pod reserve (20 pct, empties ~250 m). When cue gate opens (~39.7 min): cue clear_rudder. Then 60 s later check push_local recovers to ~-0.35 and shaft back to ~222; finish cue at 550 m to go.

text: no cue (gate closed about 40 s): suspect weed on the rudder since about 7480 m (boat 0.17 m/s slower than power and current explain); will cue clear_rudder when the gate opens.

arguments.text: Min 39.1 (7644 m): drag_jump fired, but deficit now shrinking (push_local -0.45 vs fitted -0.35, was -0.57) as shaft eases 264 -> 252 after the tell cue. May be sprint inefficiency at rate 69, not weed. At gate open (check_settle watch ~39.8 min): if deficit still >0.12 with shaft near 225, cue clear_rudder; if it is back near -0.35, no weed - cue hold/ease to ~222 if still high.

text: no cue (gate closed 30 s): the speed shortfall is shrinking as the paddler eases, so weed is uncertain; re-check when the gate opens.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging. One back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

arguments.message: Check push_local vs fitted current after clear_rudder, and paddler power (cue gate open)

arguments.text: Min 39.8 (7750 m, 1500 to go): shaft collapsed to 167 W at rate 68, fade -18 pct = second blow-up after their own early sprint (257-267 W). Drag deficit persists at low power too (push_local -0.48 vs fitted -0.37; water speed 2.87 vs ~3.0 expected at 167 W) -> cued clear_rudder. Next (check_after_clear ~41 min): if deficit gone, good; let them recover then finish cue at 550 m to go (final_500 watch). Cues left 9.

text: Cued clear_rudder: the boat has been 0.1-0.18 m/s slower than power and current explain since about 7480 m, at high and low power; the paddler has also blown up after their early sprint.
no cue (gate closed 28 s): the readings still include the back-stroke to clear the rudder and the blow-up recovery; re-check at the post-clear watch.

arguments.text: Min 41.1 (7927 m, 1323 to go): after clear_rudder the drag deficit shrank to 0.04-0.10 m/s (push_local -0.45 vs fitted -0.41; fit may have absorbed some). Paddler still blown up: 165 W, effort 8/10. No cue: let them recover (first blow-up took ~2.5 min). Recovered watch will wake me; finish cue at 560 m to go (final_500 watch). 9 cues left.

text: no cue: the rudder clear seems to have removed most of the drag; the paddler is still recovering from the blow-up (165 W at 8/10), so pushing would not help.

arguments.text: Min 44.1 (8399 m, 851 to go): clear_rudder did act (momentum dip at 40.5, then +0.07-0.08 m/s at same power). Residual 0.07-0.14 m/s below the leg-5 speed/power relation remains (fitted current now -0.42 vs -0.35 earlier; may be stronger current or tired blade at rate 69). Paddler stuck in blow-up pattern: ~165 W with brief surges to 240 that collapse. No cue now; finish cue at 560 m to go (final_500 watch).

text: no cue: paddler still blown up at about 165 W with brief surges that collapse; saving the finish cue for 560 m to go.

arguments.message: About 420 m to go on the last leg: cue finish (everything left) unless already sprinting hard

arguments.text: Min 44.8 (8523 m, 727 to go): paddler started own sprint (263 W) about 720 m from the finish I told them, into the head current before the 8750 turn - spending into the current is worth more, so no cue. Moved final watch to 430 m to go: there cue finish to squeeze out the rest (no cue in last 100 m).

text: no cue: paddler has begun their own finish sprint into the head current, which is the best place to spend it; finish cue planned at 430 m to go.

arguments.message: About 360 m to go: cue finish now (everything left)

text: no cue: the paddler collapsed again after a one-minute surge; their surges last about a minute, so the finish cue moves to about 360 m to go.

arguments.text: Last 350 metres. Everything you have left, go now!

text: Cued finish at 363 m to go: everything left for the last stretch with the current.
